title: Kulka - AntyLeak
description: Replaces all blocks that can leak your base with netherite blocks so you never accidentally leak it.
body:
This texture pack replaces all blocks that can **reveal your base coordinates** with netherite textures.

Gravel, tuff, deepslate, ores and bedrock all have unique patterns that experienced players can use to read your **exact coordinates and base location** — even through a stream or Discord screenshare. This pack makes all of them look identical, so nobody can figure out where you are.

## Blocks replaced

| Block | Block |
|-------|-------|
| `deepslate` | `deepslate_diamond_ore` |
| `deepslate_top` | `deepslate_gold_ore` |
| `cobbled_deepslate` | `deepslate_iron_ore` |
| `tuff` | `deepslate_lapis_ore` |
| `calcite` | `deepslate_redstone_ore` |
| `gravel` | `amethyst_block` |
| `bedrock` | |

> No more coord leaks — gravel patterns, bedrock layout and ore rotations can't give away your location if they all look the same.
